dialogue.line: You relocated to the underground Night City, and had a good rest until the moon rose.
How come I wasn't aware of anything?
It's the magical notebook playing a trick on you… (She giggles.) Just kidding. Previous archaeologists observed something similar. Your consciousness in Day and Night seems to separate on the Twins.
Then how should I proceed with my investigation?
Use the notebook to record and compare. Ask about each city at its own time of day: Day City in daylight, Night City at night.
You've made progress. You've established the link between the crescent icon and the moon.
But that tells me nothing about what the moon means as a symbol in Day City.
You can ask over the field radio—but only when the sun rises.
Then let me bring back the sun.
